categories.title: Woody's Roundup
categories.intro: Yee-haw! It's Toy Story 2's famous cowboy gang. [laughs] Remember, no reaching for your pull string.

clues.clue: This yodeling cowgirl doll joins Woody's gang in Toy Story 2.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jessie! [excited] Yodel-ay-hee-HOO! That one was a gimme, partner.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, Woody learns he starred in a puppet TV show from this decade.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the 1950s! [chuckles] Black and white TV, sock hops... and one very wobbly marionette sheriff.

clues.clue: Jessie remembers her old owner in this heartbreaking Toy Story 2 song, sung by Sarah McLachlan.
choices: You've Got a Friend in Me
I Will Go Sailing No More
clues.reveal: The correct answer is When She Loved Me. [sighs] Excuse me... I've got something in my eye. Both eyes. Every time.

clues.clue: Jessie's first owner, the little girl who outgrew her and left her in a donation box, was named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Emily! [sighs] Poor Jessie. And Molly is Andy's little sister, if you were tempted.

clues.clue: Toy Story 2's toy Cleaner, who fixes Woody's arm, is Geri, the old man from this Oscar-winning 1997 Pixar short.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Geri's Game! [mischievously] He beat himself at chess, then moved on to toy repair. A man of many talents.

categories.title: Home on the Range
categories.intro: Where the deer and the antelope play... and where Disney heads OUT WEST. [chuckles] Giddy-up!

clues.clue: In Home on the Range, a trio of these farm animals goes after a cattle rustler to save their farm.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is cows! [laughs] Udderly brave. I'm sorry. Not sorry.

clues.clue: In Home on the Range, show-off Buck is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a horse! Buck is a stallion who REALLY wants to be a hero. Relatable.

clues.clue: This yodeling cattle rustler hypnotizes whole herds in Home on the Range.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alameda Slim! [mischievously] Rico's the bounty hunter, Lucky Jack's the rabbit... and Slim's the one with the yodel.

clues.clue: Fess Parker's 1950s Disney frontier hero set off a national craze for raccoon-skin caps.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Davy Crockett! King of the Wild Frontier. [chuckles] Fess Parker played Daniel Boone later, on TV, which is the trap here.

clues.clue: In 1948's Melody Time, cowboy legend Pecos Bill rides this horse.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Widowmaker! [dramatic pause] Scariest horse name in Disney history. I'd walk.

categories.title: Frontierland Photo Op
categories.intro: Yee-haw! We're heading to Frontierland. [excited] Some of these come with real photos, so smile for the camera!

clues.clue: Hold onto your hats! Name this runaway mine train coaster in Magic Kingdom's Frontierland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Thunder Mountain Railroad! [laughs] The wildest ride in the wilderness, and those red rocks never get old.

clues.clue: This paddle-wheel steamboat has cruised Disneyland's Rivers of America since 1955. Name the boat.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Mark Twain Riverboat! [chuckles] Liberty Belle is the paddle-wheeler at Magic Kingdom, if you were tempted.

categories.title: Wanted Posters
categories.intro: [dramatic pause] WANTED... dead or alive... the correct answer! Name the Disney outlaw from the poster.

clues.clue: WANTED: a sly fox who robs from the rich and gives to the poor in Nottingham.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Robin Hood! [laughs] Oo-de-lally, that was an easy one.

clues.clue: WANTED: a pirate captain with a hook for a hand, last seen fleeing a ticking crocodile.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Captain Hook! [whispers] Tick-tock, tick-tock... that croc is STILL hungry.

clues.clue: WANTED: a pair of identical red-haired thieving brothers who were Flynn Rider's old partners in crime.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Stabbington Brothers! [whispers] Two identical scowls, one big grudge against Flynn. Creepy.

clues.clue: WANTED: this big, bad cat who has menaced Mickey since 1928's Steamboat Willie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pete! [chuckles] He's actually older than Mickey. Rude AND senior.

clues.clue: WANTED: Mr. Potato Head, playing this train-robbing outlaw in the Wild West opening of Toy Story 3.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is One-Eyed Bart! [laughs] With One-Eyed Betty and their attack dogs with built-in force fields. Dr. Porkchop is Hamm's villain.
